claims.text: EPT: treat sex partners by giving the pt meds or an Rx for them, as allowed by law
claims.quote: Expedited partner therapy (EPT) is a harm-reduction strategy and the clinical practice of treating the sex partners of persons with diagnosed chlamydia or gonorrhea, who are unable or unlikely to seek timely treatment, by providing medications or prescriptions to the patient as allowable by law.
claims.locator: Workowski KA, et al. Sexually Transmitted Infections Treatment Guidelines, 2021. MMWR Recomm Rep. 2021;70(4):1-187 (PMC8344968)

claims.quote: Considering limited data and potential for other bacterial STIs among MSM partners, shared clinical decision-making regarding EPT is recommended.
claims.locator: Workowski KA, et al. Sexually Transmitted Infections Treatment Guidelines, 2021. MMWR Recomm Rep. 2021;70(4):1-187 (PMC8344968)
